scripts.test: sh -c 'rm -rf .test-dist; tsc --ignoreConfig src/render-lifecycle.ts src/numeric-input-limits.ts src/combatant-turn-markers.ts src/conditions/condition-model.ts src/persistence/encounter-change-tracker.ts src/roster/monster-combat-stats.ts src/initiative/combatant-reorder.ts src/initiative/combatant-reorder-state.ts src/persistence/encounter-migration.ts src/encounter-card-model.ts src/campaign/campaign-roster.ts src/health-control-ui.ts src/encounter-card-renderer.ts --outDir .test-dist --module ESNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution Bundler --skipLibCheck; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then node --test test/render-lifecycle.test.mjs test/numeric-input-limits.test.mjs test/combatant-turn-markers.test.mjs test/condition-model.test.mjs test/frontend-architecture.test.mjs test/monster-combat-stats.test.mjs test/combatant-reorder.test.mjs test/combatant-reorder-state.test.mjs test/campaign-roster.test.mjs test/encounter-migration.test.mjs test/encounter-persistence.test.mjs test/dom-contracts.test.mjs test/reliability-contracts.test.mjs; status=$?; fi; rm -rf .test-dist; exit $status'
